lines.text: The editor never reopens a photo over and over: after a graphics reset it opens once in a lighter mode.
Zoomed out, Sharpening shows as your export will have it; zoomed in, full detail then Starfish load when you stop.
A small note under the zoom's red dot says what is loading.
Opening a photo again shows its sharper copy at once, and the editor stays within your phone's memory.
